settings.customstatus.title: Custom Status
settings.customstatus.desc: Override Discord activity with your own custom status!
customstatus.tutorial.intro: Welcome to Custom Status. It replaces the website activity with your own status on Discord.
customstatus.tutorial.profiles: Profiles are named presets. Select one here, create a new one with the plus button, delete it, or reset unsaved edits.
customstatus.tutorial.fields: Build the status here: activity type, name (required - shown as the title), details, state, link, image URL and up to two buttons.
customstatus.tutorial.preview: The preview shows exactly how your status will look on Discord. Everything you type appears here live.
customstatus.tutorial.save: Save applies your edits to the selected profile (the name field above renames it). Save as New creates a new profile from the current form.
customstatus.tutorial.activate: Flip this switch to activate the mode. If no profile exists yet, the current form is saved as a default profile automatically.
customstatus.tutorial.activeMode: While active, website activities are paused and Discord only shows your custom status. Editing any field turns the mode off; save and re-enable to apply changes.

lastfm.tutorial.intro: Welcome to the Last.fm section. The music you listen to on supported sites is scrobbled to your Last.fm profile. This quick guide walks you through the setup.
lastfm.tutorial.toggle: This switch turns scrobbling on or off. If your account is not authorized yet, the settings dialog opens automatically when you enable it.
lastfm.tutorial.settingsBtn: Open the connection settings here. Built-in API credentials are used automatically, so it works right away; you can enter your own Last.fm API key and secret instead.
lastfm.tutorial.auth: In the dialog, click this button: a Last.fm approval page opens. Once you approve it there, the session key is saved automatically - no manual copying needed.
lastfm.tutorial.status: This row shows your connection state: Connected means scrobbling is ready. If it says Not authorized, connect your account with the button above.
lastfm.tutorial.search: Use the search to narrow down the list of detected activity sites.
lastfm.tutorial.sourceList: Sites where music playback was detected are listed here. Only listen-mode (music) sites are offered for scrobbling.
lastfm.tutorial.allowList: Only sites allowed in this list scrobble to Last.fm. Drag a site here or use the plus button on its row to allow it; remove the ones you do not want.
lastfm.tutorial.activate: You are all set: authorize once, allow a site and keep the toggle on - every track played there is then scrobbled automatically.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.step1: You can open the settings by clicking on a website.
tutorial.step2: You can enable/disable the website by clicking on its switch.
tutorial.step3: You can add a custom website by clicking the "Add Site" button.
tutorial.step4: You can manage your scripts by clicking the "Open Script Manager" button.
tutorial.step5: You can change settings by clicking the "Settings" button.
tutorial.step6: You can block or edit title/artist by clicking the "Open Filters" button.
tutorial.step7: You can create your own Discord status by clicking the "Custom Status" button.
tutorial.step8: You can access the server dashboard by clicking the "Open Dashboard" button.
tutorial.step9: You can click the "Open Activity Library" button to install activities.
